object.name: evi.warmer~
object.description: Based on an idea by Tom Szilagyi. Contains two asymmetric saturation stages with a foldover boosting function and tone control filter. The effect can be blended between atan and asymmetric like behaviour, and the tonal characteristics can be continuously morphed.

attributes.name: blend
attributes.description: One of the key parameters (along with 'drive') that shape the tonal quality of the object. @blend will only have an impact if @drive is > 0. Blends the colour of the waveshaping distortion function. Positive blend is a more asymmetric sound than the cleaner negative blend.

attributes.name: decouplegain
attributes.description: If @decouplegain is off, @ingain and @outgain are ignored and the object responds to the @gain attribute which reciprocally adjusts input and output gains around unity. If @decouplegain is on, the @gain attribute is ignored and input and output gains are controlled individually by the @ingain and @outgain attributes.

attributes.name: drive
attributes.description: One of the key parameters (along with 'blend') that shape the tonal quality of the object. In general, drive will increase the gain and increase the harmonics in the output, but this depends on the @blend attribute. Lower drive values will make the sound darker, higher values will make it brighter.

attributes.name: fold
attributes.description: '0' or 'soft' sets soft clipping internally, '1' or 'hard' sets hard (folding) clipping internally.

attributes.name: foldgain
attributes.description: Only active if @fold attribute is on. Boost effect into the folding distortion circuit, set by the @fold attribute. Very high values are increasingly aggressive, lower values give a softer sound. With very high values the entire output can alias, depending on the material fed into the circuit, so be careful!

attributes.name: foldmix
attributes.description: Only active if @fold attribute is on. Mix duty cycle like effect of the foldover clipping circuit. Higher values are harsher.

attributes.name: foldslope
attributes.description: Only active if @fold attribute is on and @foldmix is > 0. The slope of the @foldmix attribute, the higher (smoother) the value the softer the folding portion of the waveform.

attributes.name: gain
attributes.description: Activation depends on the '@decouplegain' attribute: @gain is active if @decouplegain is off. The @gain attribute reciprocally adjusts input and output gains around unity. Positive dB boost input and attenuates output, negative dB does the opposite.

attributes.name: ingain
attributes.description: Activation depends on the '@decouplegain' attribute: @ingain and @outgain are active if @decouplegain is on. The @ingain attribute sets the audio input gain to the saturation processes beween -24 and +24 dB.

attributes.name: outgain
attributes.description: Activation depends on the '@decouplegain' attribute: @outgain and @ingain are active if @decouplegain is on. The @outgain attribute sets the audio output gain of the whole saturation chain beween -24 and +24 dB.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: If @tone is on, high frequencies are attenuated by the @tonecutoff and @toneslope attributes. If @tone is off, there is no high frequency attenuation and the @tonecutoff and @toneslope attributes have no effect.

attributes.name: tonecutoff
attributes.description: If @tone is on: the cutoff frequency of the tone filter. The tone filter is a variable order (set by the @toneslope attribute) butterworth lowpass and can be used to make severe tonal cuts in the audio output or subtle attenuation of the high frequency content.

attributes.name: toneslope
attributes.description: If @tone is on: the order of the butterworth tone shaping filter. Higher orders produce a steeper slope/cut. The cutoff frequency is set by the @tonecutoff attribute.
